name: simspaceweaver

subcommands.description: Creates a snapshot of the specified simulation. A snapshot is a file that contains simulation state data at a specific time.

subcommands.name: start-simulation
subcommands.description: Starts a simulation with the given name. You must choose to start your simulation from a schema or from a snapshot.

options.name: --client-token
options.description: A value that you provide to ensure that repeated calls to this API operation using the same parameters complete only once.

options.name: --description
options.description: The description of the simulation

options.name: --maximum-duration
options.description: The maximum running time of the simulation, specified as a number of minutes (m or M), hours (h or H), or days (d or D).

options.name: --name
options.description: The name of the simulation

options.name: --role-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) role that the simulation assumes to perform actions.

options.name: --schema-s3-location
options.description: The location of the simulation schema in Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3).

options.name: --snapshot-s3-location
options.description: The location of the snapshot .zip file in Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3).
